hotel.name: Palazzo Cordusio, a Gran Meliá Hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Piazza Cordusio in the heart of Milan, near the Piazza del Duomo and the Quadrilatero della Moda fashion district.
verified_facts.excerpt: is located in the heart of the city, near the Piazza del Duomo and the Quadrilatero della Moda

verified_facts.text: The hotel is minutes from the Duomo and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, with easy access to La Scala and the Castello Sforzesco.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in the heart of Milan, just minutes from the Duomo and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II. Located in a historic 19th-century palace in Piazza Cordusio, the hotel offers easy access to La Scala, the Castello Sforzesco

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies the 19th-century former headquarters of Assicurazioni Generali, designed by architect Luca Beltrami.
verified_facts.excerpt: The former headquarters of Assicurazioni Generali, where this hotel is located, were designed in the 19th century by the famous architect Luca Beltrami

verified_facts.text: Luca Beltrami also designed Piazza della Scala and restored the Castello Sforzesco.
verified_facts.excerpt: who designed the Piazza La Scala and the restoration of the Castello Sforzesco

verified_facts.text: The restored facade keeps its reliefs, including the lion of San Marco and a niche with an allegorical mosaic of Providence.
verified_facts.excerpt: the splendour of its façade has been restored, maintaining its eclectic flair and elegant reliefs, such as the lion of San Marco and the niche with the allegorical mosaic of Providence

verified_facts.text: It is the first Gran Melia hotel in Milan.
verified_facts.excerpt: The first Gran Meliá in Milan is a 19th-century architectural jewel

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has two rooftop terraces with views of the Duomo.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel features two exclusive rooftop terraces offering breathtaking views of Milan’s iconic Duomo Cathedral.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are decorated with Rubelli textiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: A bedroom featuring stunning classical interiors that mix delicate finishings with the exquisite Rubelli textiles

verified_facts.text: Some rooms and suites have balconies overlooking the Sforza Castle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the extraordinary beauty of Milan from the balcony of this room overlooking the Sforza Castle.

verified_facts.text: The Duomo View Suite has a view of the cathedral and a separate living room.
verified_facts.excerpt: This suite, offering a unique view of the cathedral and the city centre, enjoys a privileged location for admiring one of Milan's icons. It is decorated with the famous Rubelli textiles and features a bedroom and a separate living room.

verified_facts.text: The Cordusio Suite has a private terrace overlooking Piazza Cordusio and Molteni furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Admire the magnificent views of Piazza Cordusio from the private terrace of this suite. The most sought-after space in Palazzo Cordusio features a separate living room with Molteni furniture

verified_facts.text: The spa has a large indoor pool, a gym, a sauna and a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: a large indoor pool where you can enjoy a refreshing swim, gym, sauna and steam room

verified_facts.text: The gym is filled with natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: A space filled with natural light that will enable you to continue your daily training routine.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a personalized butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Among the services offered are: Personalized Butler Service, Rooftop area, Heated pool

verified_facts.text: The concierge offers families children's services designed in partnership with FAO Schwarz Milano.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Concierge guides families through exclusive services for children in the store and hotel, designed in partnership with FAO Schwarz Milano.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly, with a welcome gift and treats for pets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a life well lived in this exclusive pet-friendly hotel in Milan. Our distinguished and warm atmosphere is perfect for your pet to enjoy walks in the public areas as well as a welcome gift

verified_facts.text: Sachi, a Japanese restaurant, has a panoramic rooftop on the 4th floor with views of the Duomo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our panoramic rooftop on the 4th floor of the iconic Palazzo Cordusio offers breathtaking views of the Duomo di Milano

verified_facts.text: Isola Restaurant is on the hotel's top floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor of the iconic Palazzo Cordusio Gran Meliá, Isola Restaurant presents a unique dining experience in the vibrant heart of Milan.

verified_facts.text: Guests have free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, guests staying at the hotel have free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

subjective.text: The spa is for adults only (18 and over).
